KEN.note: The article states no rule, authority or enforcement on AI harms.

facts.fact: Kenyans.co.ke reports, from Digital Health Agency tender documents seen on 25 August 2026, that the agency floated seven tenders including an AI-driven RMNCAH digital health platform, an AI-managed national blood bank system and an AI birth-and-death notification registry for Taifa Care.

KEN.note: The article names no national AI strategy.
The tenders are for health platforms; the article does not say an AI model, dataset or AI computing is built or hosted in the country.
